design.objective: S = -2 sum(native component loglikelihoods) + sum[((Gaussian calibration parameter - prior mean)/sigma)^2]. Uniform-prior support is enforced, but prior-density normalization constants are not part of S.
design.optimization_method: L-BFGS-B, finite-difference step2e-4 in author Cholesky coordinates, trustbox±4; no active source changes
design.native_optimization: None: evaluate candidate positions only; no exact stationarity certification.

lcdm.scope: Author moments set numerical starting/scaling coordinates only; box is a declared optimization restriction, not a change to the scientific target.

cpl.scope: Author moments set numerical starting/scaling coordinates only; box is a declared optimization restriction, not a change to the scientific target.

native_comparison.meaning: Difference between best native-evaluated candidates. Not certified profile minima, posterior probability, Bayes factor, or sigma. Native component normalization is retained, so objective is not a global goodness-of-fit chi-square.
